name: Bergheimat
beschreibung: The Hotel Bergheimat is located in the municipality of Pfafflar in Außerfern. The family-run hotel offers overnight stays in various room categories. The surroundings of the Lechtaler Alpen are ideal for hiking and cycling tours. In winter, guests can go cross-country skiing or take excursions to the ski areas. The in-house kitchen emphasizes regional products. The hotel has a guest garden and a lounge. Pfafflar is a quiet starting point for nature experiences away from the main tourist crowds.
